name: Lawn fertilization & weed-control subscription route for single-family subdivisions in DuPage/Will (independent, IDOA Turf-licensed)
summary: Customers = households on an auto-renewing 5-6 application program sold by direct mail/door hangers/online instant quotes in dense subdivisions; founder is the first licensed applicator driving one truck with a <=100-gal skid sprayer loaded at a permitted portable (General Class A) containment pad. Engine spreads revenue evenly though applications run ~Apr-Nov and selling peaks Feb-May.
evidence_notes: Spring-Green 2026 FDD Item 19 (CY2025): avg revenue per customer $585 (median $595, range $401-$967); gross profit 68.4% after materials 12.9% and direct labor 18.8%; gross sales per full-time production vehicle $209,478; marketing 7.4% of revenue returning $2.62 of new-service revenue per $1; retention 81.2% (64.9-93.0%); smallest unit $123,254 [B, DE-S027, DE-S028].

Weed Man 2026 FDD: 149 units avg $2.04M, bottom quartile $347k, low $96k [B, WS18-S007]; Lawn Doctor 2026 FDD (summary): 202 units 2+ yrs avg net revenue $1.17M, median $616k, low $15k; royalty 10% + marketing fund 5% [C, DE-S029]. Mature-franchise numbers are incumbent economics.

Licensing: IDOA commercial applicator $300/3 yrs (Turf category), operators $240 [A, C2-S026]. Containment: permit needed for any turf-pesticide loading/rinse area before use; $250 fee; General Class A portable pad allowed for <=100-gal devices; fertilizer-only exempt [A, DE-S030, DE-S031, DE-S032].

Competition: Illinois 4,949 landscaping firms [C, DE-S002]; 1,132 permitted lawncare facilities (2011) [A, DE-S033]; TruGreen, Spring-Green (HQ Plainfield), Weed Man, Lawn Doctor, plus Landscape Illinois members (955) [C, DE-S034].
Chicago-area per-application prices MISSING; ARPC set below Spring-Green's mature $585 because a new entrant sells fewer add-ons (E).
Owner draw $4,000/mo from month 13 (comparability); operating profit is before owner compensation.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: IDOA exams (online-proctored) + $250 containment permit before use + insurance [A, C2-S026, DE-S032]
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Annual-average quote requests from direct mail/door hangers/search (seasonal peak Feb-May)
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Neighbour referrals and yard signs in dense subdivisions
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Spring-Green retention 81.2% (~1.7%/mo) for mature franchisees, range 64.9-93.0% [B, DE-S027]; new entrant assumed worse
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: $432/$504/$576 per year vs Spring-Green avg $585, range $401-$967 [B, DE-S027]
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Materials 12.9% of revenue (Spring-Green CY2025; 12.8% CY2024) + ~1% consumables; applicator labor modeled as staff [B, DE-S027, DE-S028]
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Spring-Green: $1 marketing -> $2.62 new-services revenue, i.e. ~$223 per $585 of new revenue [B, DE-S027]; unbranded entrant assumed similar-to-worse
